protocol.target: 15th future close > frozen reference versus <= reference; not first candle or monotone path
protocol.branch: zero-output94-input24-hidden GRU; repeated92 flow means plus two midpoint summaries, disabled or enabled; raw frozen0.5 parent
protocol.loss: both arms: near-weighted rangeCE +.25colourCE +1.0 final binary CE from summed price bins
protocol.selection: lowest3-seed mean development FINAL binary log loss, epoch0 allowed; fixedseed17; no_midpoint breaks ties; freeze before calibration/benchmark
protocol.calibration: same calibration for both arms: h1-14 binNLL; h15 binary endpointNLL using full26-bin temperature; .5..2 grid; colour separate. Raw neural parents used without old fitted temperatures; calibrate new marginal pipeline once. October dates still reused in research.
protocol.joint: fixed unit coupling to raw0.7 transition kernel at temperature1; no old fitted temperatures
protocol.cohort: same0.5 purged October origins; no future features or changed target labels
limitations: Repeatedly inspected benchmark, not fresh holdout.
A correct distribution can assign probability to both sides; never erase downside after Reveal.
Direction might stay near50-50; no promise of confidence or profitable entries.
Equality belongs to down_or_unchanged, not silently pure down.
